settings.label: Brew perfectly
settings.body: 93°C water, 5-minute steep, gentle stir at 2:30. Don't squeeze the filter — let it drip dry over the cup before composting.

settings.label: What's inside
settings.body: Single-origin beans, roasted in small batches, ground the same week. Plant-fiber filter, plant-based corn-starch wrapper.

settings.label: Ships when
settings.body: Orders out the door in 2 business days. Flat $5 shipping; free over $40.

settings.label: Aroma
settings.body: Light and floral up front. Like opening a window.

settings.label: Palate
settings.body: Bright, juicy, easy to drink without milk.

settings.label: Finish
settings.body: Dries off without bitterness. Asks for another.

settings.title: Boil.
settings.body: Fresh water, just off the boil. Around 93°C. A kettle whistle works fine.

settings.title: Drop.
settings.body: Place a filter in your mug. Tag out, like tea. Don't squeeze it.

settings.title: Pour.
settings.body: Fill to the brim. The steam counts. Watch the bloom for ten seconds.

settings.title: Wait.
settings.body: Five minutes. Don't check your phone.
